units.title: Company Profile
units.body:
ANGECON — Shanghai Anji Xiekang Biotechnology Co., Ltd. — founded in February 2010, is a clinical-stage biotechnology company developing human neural stem cell (hNSC) therapeutics from discovery through clinical translation.

Based in Shanghai, we operate a GMP-compliant cell manufacturing facility, an R&D center and a dedicated cell-testing center.

Mission: cell therapies that ordinary patients can afford. Vision: a world-class cell company.

Milestones
2016 — China's first qualified biobank certificate
2022 — Clinical research filing for spinal cord injury
2025 — US FDA Drug Master File (Type II); INCI name assigned
2026 — FDA clinical trial clearances for three indications (subject to official release)

units.title: Scientific Heritage
units.body:
Our science descends from the laboratory that first isolated neural stem cells.

Dr. Sally Temple — first isolated neural stem cells (1989)
Qin Shen — trainee of Dr. Temple; discovered the neural stem cell niche mechanism; founded ANGECON
Xicai Sun — trainee of Prof. Shen; works on migration regulation and clinical translation; Chief Technology Officer

A discovery made in 1989 has become a clinical-stage pipeline — carried by three generations of the same scientific lineage.

units.title: Anku Biomed
units.body:
Shanghai Anku Biomed Biotechnology Co., Ltd. — founded in October 2017 — is a wholly owned subsidiary of ANGECON.

Anku Biomed focuses on cells and small extracellular vesicles (sEV): R&D, application development and technical services, built on the parent company's platform and quality systems.

Its exosome program holds a US FDA Drug Master File (Type II) under MF 31537.

units.title: NSC Drug Development Platform
units.body:
An integrated platform for innovative neural stem cell drug development: covering the full chain from cell bank establishment and CMC production to clinical development; addressing key technologies in sustained expansion, directed differentiation, cryopreservation and recovery, with quality control aligned to Chinese and US regulatory submission standards.

Quality & Standards: A full-process quality traceability and release quality control system has been established; products have passed quality control and safety testing by the National Institutes for Food and Drug Control (NIFDC); ISO 9001 certification has been obtained; the company participates in standard development by TC559, the national technical committee for biobank standardization.

units.title: NSC Exosome Drug Development Platform
units.body: Based on neural stem cell paracrine mechanisms, the platform develops new approaches to cell-free therapy using exosomes; in 2025, it obtained a US FDA Type II Drug Master File (DMF) filing for an active pharmaceutical ingredient and an INCI name for an international cosmetic ingredient.

units.title: Cell Bank
units.body: A clinical-grade cell resource platform: storage capacity on the scale of 4 million samples, with a three-tier seed bank → master bank → working bank system; each sample is handled separately to prevent cross-contamination; it has passed three consecutive Biobank Quality Compliance Inspections since 2016.

units.title: Drug Development Pipeline
units.body: Seven indication areas: Parkinson's disease, Alzheimer's disease, early-onset Parkinson's disease, spinal cord injury, amyotrophic lateral sclerosis, pediatric cerebral palsy and ischemic stroke; spanning six stages from drug discovery to FDA IND.

units.title: Clinical Research
units.body:
Parkinson’s Disease: In collaboration with Peking Union Medical College Hospital; results of a Phase I study of intranasal human neural stem cell transplantation for Parkinson's disease were published in 2024 (JNNP); intranasal delivery is non-invasive throughout. These are research findings, subject to official announcements.

Spinal Cord Injury: In collaboration with Tongji Hospital affiliated with Tongji University (Prof. Liming Cheng's team); in June 2026, the study of human neural stem cells for spinal cord injury completed the biomedical new technology clinical research filing with China's National Health Commission (NHC).

Stroke & Pediatric Cerebral Palsy: The ischemic stroke study is led by Prof. Yangtai Guan's team at Renji Hospital; the pediatric cerebral palsy study is conducted in collaboration with the First Affiliated Hospital of Anhui Medical University; all 5 stem cell clinical research projects received a Grade B rating.

AD & Exosome Pipeline: The clinical study of exosomes for moderate-to-severe early-onset Alzheimer's disease, led by Shanghai Mental Health Center, received clinical research approval (2025); the three indications in the exosome pipeline are at the preclinical stage.

units.title: Publications
units.body:
The team and collaborating institutions have published related papers, including JNNP 2024, J Immunother Cancer 2025, Neuron 2017, Science 2004 and Nature 1989; all can be looked up by DOI.

ANGE-S003 Research: A 12-month Phase I study in 18 patients with advanced Parkinson's disease (intranasal transplantation, dose escalation); it provides safety and preliminary efficacy signals, rather than definitive conclusions on efficacy.

Filing & Regulatory Progress: Two biomedical new technology clinical research filings with China's National Health Commission (Renji / Tongji); 5 studies received a Grade B rating; exosomes obtained an FDA Type II DMF filing for an active pharmaceutical ingredient (filing number MF 31537, as disclosed by the company).

Research Foundation: 16 years of dedicated work since the company's founding in 2010; a large-scale cell production system has been established and real-world research data accumulated; long-term clinical research collaborations have been established with leading Grade III Class A hospitals.
